brinkmann.label: where the wave pushes
legend: light parallel to the axis at $u = 0$
caption: The surface $y = 0$ of the Brinkmann chart of the vacuum member, $v$ left out, $x$ across and $cu$ up. The wave pushes along $x$: light from the origin runs out as $x = sL\sinh(cu/L)$ for any slope $s$, and light parallel to the axis as $x = a\cosh(cu/L)$, with $a$ any length.

brinkmann.label: where the wave pulls
legend: light parallel to the axis at $u = 0$
caption: The surface $x = 0$ of the Brinkmann chart of the vacuum member, $y$ across and $cu$ up. The wave pulls along $y$: light from the origin swings as $y = sL\sin(cu/L)$ for any slope $s$ and meets again at $cu = \pi L$.

rosen.label: where the wave pushes
legend: light parallel to the axis at $u = 0$
caption: The surface $q = 0$ of the Rosen chart, $p$ across and $cu$ up. Light from the origin of the Brinkmann chart runs straight up, since $x = p\sinh(kcu)$, and light parallel to the axis along $p = a\coth(kcu)$, with $a$ any length.

rosen.label: where the wave pulls
legend: light parallel to the axis at $u = 0$
caption: The surface $p = 0$ of the Rosen chart, $q$ across and $cu$ up. Light from the origin of the Brinkmann chart runs straight up, and the chart ends at the foci of that light, $u = 0$ and $kcu = \pi$.

rotating.label: light turning with the axes
caption: Light leaving the origin of the rotating chart, $v$ left out. The wave pulls every ray back as the axes turn, so each ray runs round a circle through the axis and closes onto it at $cu = \pi L$.
